candidates.title: 前缀块哈希的跨请求重复工作

Frozen8 text requests have8 distinct full hashes and share at least117286 characters;2 prefix seeds are outside formal statistics.
Frontend exported traces contain only profiler-window markers; no hash/tokenizer function costs.
candidates.source_answer: The existing request block hasher already computes only new complete blocks and chains each block to its previous prefix hash. Incremental hashing within a request is already implemented.
candidates.candidate_graph: A conditional cross-request reuse edge may avoid recomputing an exactly identical hash prefix; this is distinct from already implemented per-request append hashing.
rejected_overclaims: Historical resolved hash block size is established as128.

Shared text prefixes can tokenize differently at a boundary.
candidates.resource: No hash CPU cost, retained cache bytes or same-domain time bound is known; do not rank by prefix-hit fraction.
minimal_missing_evidence: Actual hash call counts/cost and repeated exact token/hash-extra identities under the same resolved H.
